title: fanoutqa: What are the birth years of the last five solo Pritzker Prize winners? (844997c932888c54)

chat_history.content: What are the birth years of the last five solo Pritzker Prize winners?

content.content:
We need to find last five solo Pritzker Prize winners (i.e., individuals, not firms) and their birth years. Need up-to-date info. As of 2025, the most recent Pritzker laureates: 2024 (Sir David Adjaye? Actually 2024 winner: Sir David Adjaye? Let's recall: 2024 Pritzker Prize awarded to David Adjaye (British-Ghanaian architect). 2023 winner: David Chipperfield? Actually 2023 winner was David Chipperfield (British). 2022: Francis Kéré (Burkinabé). 2021: Anne Lacaton and Jean-Philippe Vassal (joint, so not solo). 2020: Yvonne Farrell and Shelley McNamara (joint). 2019: Arata Isozaki (solo). 2018: Balkrishna Doshi (solo). 2017: Rafael Moneo (solo). Need last five solo winners: Starting from most recent solo: 2024 David Adjaye (solo), 2023 David Chipperfield (solo), 2022 Francis Kéré (solo), 2019 Arata Isozaki (solo), 2018 Balkrishna Doshi (solo). That's five solo winners. Need birth years: David Adjaye born 1966. David Chipperfield born 1953. Francis Kéré born 1965. Arata Isozaki born 1931. Balkrishna Doshi born 1927 (died 2023). Provide answer. Also note that 2021 and 2020 were joint, so excluded. Provide list.

Check birth years: Verify.

- David Adjaye: born 30 September 1966 (British-Ghanaian). Yes.

- David Chipperfield: born 26 August 1953.

- Francis Kéré: born 1965 (exact date 26 June 1965 maybe). Yes.

- Arata Isozaki: born 23 July 1931.

- Balkrishna Doshi: born 26 August 1927 (died 2023). Yes.

Provide answer.

content:
**Last five solo Pritzker Prize laureates (chronologically) and their birth years**

| Year (Solo) | Laureate | Birth year |
|-------------|----------|------------|
| 2024 | **Sir David Adjaye** (British‑Ghanaian architect) | **1966** |
| 2023 | **David Chipperfield** (British architect) | **1953** |
| 2022 | **Francis Kéré** (Burkinabé architect) | **1965** |
| 2019 | **Arata Isozaki** (Japanese architect) | **1931** |
| 2018 | **Balkrishna Doshi** (Indian architect) | **1927** |

*Notes*

- The Pritzker Prize is awarded annually. In 2021 (Anne Lacaton & Jean‑Philippe Vassal) and 2020 (Yvonne Farrell & Shelley McNamara) the prize was given jointly, so they are not counted among “solo” winners.  
- All five architects listed above received the prize individually (i.e., not shared with another architect).
